draft.overall: NXL leads the gainers in this range, up 102 percent from the prior close, after Nexalin announced a definitive 10-year exclusive distribution and local-manufacturing agreement for Brazil and South America, found in our sources as fresh news. RPGL is up 10 percent with only older or secondary news found, a reverse split alongside recent financing, and NAMM is up 3 percent on an older term loan announcement, with a new high of day since the previous checkpoint. Fresh news turned up in our sources for 4 of the 12 names the desk covers.

lines.text: Nexalin announced a definitive 10-year exclusive distribution and local-manufacturing agreement for Brazil and South America at 08:30 ET, with secondary coverage at 08:42 ET describing seven Latin American markets; no deal value, minimum purchase commitment or revenue forecast was given. The desk reads it as a company-specific commercial development that lined up with the heavy-volume move, without evidence that it caused the move.

The company announced at 08:18 ET that it completed the sale of Altruis Benefit Consulting for $8 million plus an earnout of up to $1 million, a deal already disclosed in a September 29 filing and September 30 coverage. The desk sees meaningful proceeds toward its monetization plan, with part of the consideration in a secured note rather than cash at closing, and an uncertain informational value for the release itself.
